case_title: THE PEOPLE OF CALIF/BY & THR/THE BAY AREA QUA/MANA VS ESQUIVEL, NESTOR DBA GENESIS AUTO BODY REPAIR.

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,000.00 FILED BY THE PEOPLE OF CALIF/BY & THR/THE BAY AREA QUA/MANA AS TO DEFENDANT ESQUIVEL, NESTOR DBA GENESIS AUTO BODY REPAIR. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUL-11-2003 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT ESQUIVEL, NESTOR DBA GENESIS AUTO BODY REPAIR.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF THE PEOPLE OF CALIF/BY & THR/THE BAY AREA QUA/MANA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT ESQUIVEL, NESTOR DBA GENESIS AUTO BODY REPAIR. $1,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $72.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,072.00, DEFENDANT TO PAY IN INSTALLMENTS OF $200 PER MONTH BEGINNING AUG. 1, 2003. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT AS TO DEFENDANT ESQUIVEL, NESTOR DBA GENESIS AUTO BODY REPAIR.
